name: Russian Twist
summary: A seated bodyweight core exercise that trains rotational trunk control and hip flexor endurance by twisting the torso from side to side with elevated feet.

setup: Sit on the floor or an exercise mat with your knees bent and feet flat.
Lean your torso back to roughly a 45-degree angle while maintaining a neutral, braced spine.
Lift your feet slightly off the floor to balance on your sit bones, and hold your hands together in front of your chest.
steps: Rotate your torso to one side, bringing your hands toward the floor beside your hip.
Pause briefly under control, engaging your obliques.
Rotate your torso smoothly across the center to the opposite side to complete one repetition per side.
Continue alternating sides in a controlled, rhythmic cadence.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you rotate to each side, and take a brief inhale as your torso passes through the center.
cues: Turn your shoulders, not just your hands.
Keep your chest proud and spine tall.
Keep your knees steady and hips square.

common_faults.fault: Moving only the arms while keeping the torso stationary.
common_faults.correction: Initiate the movement by turning your ribcage and shoulders so the abdominal wall performs the rotation.
Hinge back from the hips with a braced core and neutral lumbar spine rather than slumping into lumbar flexion.

common_faults.fault: Swinging the legs erratically from side to side.
common_faults.correction: Engage your hip flexors and lower abs to stabilize the lower body, keeping your knees relatively still.

precautions: If you experience lower back discomfort, place your heels lightly on the ground to reduce shear stress on the lumbar spine.
